lead.label: 3ea
lead.why: Abstract: 'The structure-activity relationship analysis identified the compound 3ea as a potent and efficacious PAM with the maximum activation effect of the alpha7 current of over 1633% ... EC50 = 1.26 uM'; it is also the compound used in the rat PK and mouse prepulse-inhibition experiments.

reactions.conditions: Aniline (100 mmol) in glacial AcOH with saturated aq. NaOAc, ice bath, chloroacetyl chloride (1.5 equiv) dropwise, 6 h; precipitate filtered; 58%.
reactions.source: main text Experimental Section, '2-Chloro-N-(2-chloro-6-methyphenyl)acetamide (4a)'; Scheme 4 step a

reactions.conditions: 4a (5 mmol) in acetone with aq. dipotassium cyanodithioimidocarbonate (1 equiv) and 2 M NaOH (2.5 mL), rt 2 h then 80 C 0.5 h (Thorpe-Ziegler cyclisation); cooled, benzyl bromide (1 equiv) added dropwise; poured into ice water, solid filtered and dried (intermediate 10a, yield not given).
reactions.source: main text Experimental Section, procedure for 3ea; Scheme 4 steps a, b; Results text

reactions.conditions: 10a (3 mmol) in HCOOH (2 mL), reflux 1 h; quenched with water, extracted with Et2O, silica gel chromatography (PE/EtOAc 10:1); 75%, yellow solid.
reactions.source: main text Experimental Section, procedure for 3ea; Scheme 4 step c

notes: (1) The 3ea procedure calls the chloroacetamide 'compound 5a' (1.10 g, 5 mmol), but 5a is not otherwise defined; the amount and context match 4a (MW 218), whose procedure is given separately, so I used 4a. (2) The printed name of 4a is '2-Chloro-N-(2-chloro-6-methyphenyl)acetamide' (typo, 'methyphenyl'); I wrote the corrected spelling. (3) 10a has no printed name (only the number; it is the benzylthio analogue of printed compound 5, '4-Amino-N-(2-chloro-6-methylphenyl)-2-(ethylthio)thiazole-5-carboxamide'); structure derived accordingly. (4) Dipotassium cyanodithioimidocarbonate is listed as a purchased reagent in the sense of the general statement; its SMILES is written as the dianion salt K2[N#CN=C(S)S]. (5) Step 2 as written is a one-pot sequence (cyclisation then S-alkylation) with an isolated crude solid 10a; I counted it as one step.
